_comment: Example only -- not installed automatically. Merge the relevant pieces into your own ~/.claude/settings.json or a project .claude/settings.json.

hooks._comment: PreToolUse (pretool_wrap.py) is the recommended, token-saving hook: it rewrites noisy Bash commands to run through squire BEFORE execution, so only condensed output reaches the model. PostToolUse (posttool_condense.py) is opt-in only -- it can only ADD context on top of output already shown, which increases tokens; see the header comment in that file. Do not enable both on the same command class.
